crossRefs.note: Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed…
Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by…

parallels.note: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children…

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
translations.bsb: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
translations.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
translations.asv: And the rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
